arm_swings.form_cue: Swing the arms across the chest, then open wide. Relaxed shoulders.

torso_rotations.form_cue: Hips stay mostly square. Turn the ribs, smooth and controlled.

high_knee_marches.form_cue: Brace the core, stand tall, lift each knee to hip height.

half_squats.form_cue: Sit back about halfway, knees track over toes, 2 second pace.

low_impact_hops.form_cue: Feet barely leave the floor. Soft landings on the balls of the feet.

march_in_place.form_cue: Easy march, swing the arms, breathe steadily.

deep_squats.form_cue: Only as deep as comfortable. Hold a wall or doorframe. 3 second pause, no bouncing. Skip if sharp knee pain.

diaphragmatic_breathing.form_cue: 4 s in through the nose, belly expands. 6 s out through the mouth.

towel_pass_through.form_cue: Hold the towel wide. Sweep it over and behind you. Stop if painful. This is not an overhead press.

t_raise.form_cue: Lie face down, thumbs up, lift straight arms out to the sides. Squeeze the shoulder blades.

bird_dog.form_cue: Opposite arm and leg reach long. Hold 2 seconds. Keep the back flat like a table.

wall_angel.form_cue: Head, upper back and hips touch the wall. Slide the arms up and down slowly.

chin_tuck.form_cue: Head on the wall. Pull the chin straight back, no tilting. Hold 3 seconds.

dead_bug.form_cue: Lower back stays pressed to the floor. Reach the opposite arm and leg away slowly.

ankle_rocks.form_cue: Half kneel, knee drifts over the toes, heel stays down.

hip_hinge_drill.form_cue: Push the hips back, flat back, soft knees. Stand by squeezing the glutes.

scapular_push_up.form_cue: Arms straight. Let the chest sink between the shoulder blades, then push the floor away.

scapular_retraction.form_cue: Hands on the wall. Squeeze the shoulder blades together for 2 seconds.

wall_push_up.form_cue: Hands on the wall at chest height, body straight, slow down and push away.

tempo_squat.form_cue: Hold the dumbbells at the shoulders, elbows down. 4 seconds down, knees over toes, stand tall.

bulgarian_split_squat.form_cue: Rear foot on a chair or sofa. Drop the back knee straight down, front heel stays down.

single_leg_rdl.form_cue: Hinge on one leg, the free leg reaches back. Flat back, hips square.

slider_hamstring_curl.form_cue: Heels on the slider, hips up. Slide out slowly, curl back in.

calf_raise.form_cue: Hold a wall for balance. Full rise, slow lower.

plank.form_cue: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, ribs down.

romanian_deadlift.form_cue: Dumbbells slide down the thighs, hips back, flat back. 4 seconds down.

reverse_lunge.form_cue: Step back, drop the back knee straight down, push through the front heel.

glute_bridge.form_cue: Dumbbell on the hips, drive through the heels, squeeze 2 seconds at the top.

elevated_push_up.form_cue: Hands on a sofa or table edge, body straight. 4 seconds down.

floor_press.form_cue: Lie on the floor, elbows at 45 degrees, press up, upper arms touch the floor lightly.

one_arm_row.form_cue: Hand and knee on a chair, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to the hip.

lateral_raise.form_cue: Raise out to the sides to shoulder height only. Slight elbow bend.

biceps_curl.form_cue: Elbows pinned to the sides, palms up, slow lowering.

triceps_extension.form_cue: Lie down, upper arms still, bend at the elbows toward the forehead, extend.

bent_over_row.form_cue: Hinge forward, flat back, row both dumbbells to the ribs.

reverse_fly.form_cue: Hinge forward, arms slightly bent, open out wide, squeeze the shoulder blades.

close_grip_push_up.form_cue: Hands under the shoulders, elbows tucked, body straight. Hands on a sofa if needed.

single_arm_floor_press.form_cue: One dumbbell, other hand on the belly to stop twisting. Elbow at 45 degrees.

hammer_curl.form_cue: Palms face each other, elbows still, slow lowering.

plank_shoulder_taps.form_cue: High plank, feet wide, tap the opposite shoulder without rocking the hips.

side_plank.form_cue: Elbow under the shoulder, body in one line. Knees down is fine.

hollow_hold.form_cue: Lower back pressed down, shoulders and legs up. Bend the knees to make it easier.

glute_bridge_march.form_cue: Hips stay high and level while the feet march.

split_squat.form_cue: Both feet on the floor, back knee drops straight down.

push_up.form_cue: Body straight, chest to a fist height off the floor. Knees or a sofa edge are fine.
